sentences.en: Television has made it possible for people around the world to share in many different experiences – sports, music shows, films, and more.
sentences.zh: 电视使世界各地的人能够分享许多不同的经验 — — 体育、音乐节目、电影等等。

sentences.en: Yet many people would find it difficult to name the inventor of the television.
sentences.zh: 然而,许多人会发现很难给电视发明者取名。

sentences.en: They might also be surprised to learn that the inventor came up with the idea when he was just fourteen years old.
sentences.zh: 他们也可能惊讶地得知 发明者在他14岁的时候 想到了这个想法

sentences.en: Today, we explore the life of one of the great inventors of 20th century America: Philo Taylor Farnsworth.
sentences.zh: 今天,我们探索了20世纪美国伟大发明家菲洛·泰勒·法思沃斯的生活。

sentences.en: A young boy Philo Farnsworth was born in August 1906, near Indian Creek in the western state of Utah.
sentences.zh: 1906年8月出生 犹他州西部印第安溪附近

sentences.en: The house he lived in for the first few years of his life had no electricity.
sentences.zh: 他生命中头几年住的房子没有电。

sentences.en: But Philo read about electricity and quickly began to experiment with it.
sentences.zh: 但菲洛读到电力, 很快开始实验。

sentences.en: One night, Philo read a magazine story about the idea of sending pictures and sound through the air.
sentences.zh: 一天晚上,菲洛读了一个杂志故事 关于发送图片 和声音的想法 通过空气。

sentences.en: The story said some of the world’s best scientists were working on the idea.
sentences.zh: 故事中说,世界上一些最好的科学家正在研究这个想法。

sentences.en: It said these scientists were using special machines to try to make a kind of device to send pictures.
sentences.zh: 上面说这些科学家使用特殊机器 来制造一种发送照片的设备

sentences.en: Fourteen-year-old Philo decided these famous scientists were wrong.
sentences.zh: 14岁的Philo认为这些著名的科学家是错误的。

sentences.en: He decided that mechanical devices would never work.
sentences.zh: 他决定机械设备是行不通的

sentences.en: Philo believed such a device would have to be electronic.
sentences.zh: Philo认为这个装置必须是电子的

sentences.en: Philo knew electrons could be made to move very fast.
sentences.zh: Philo知道电子可以快速移动

sentences.en: All he would have to do was find a way to make electrons do the work.
sentences.zh: 他只需要找到一种方法 让电子来操作

sentences.en: Soon, Philo had an idea for such a receiver.
sentences.zh: 很快,菲洛就有了一个这样的接收器的想法。

sentences.en: It would trap light in a container and send the light on a line of electrons.
sentences.zh: 它会把光困在容器里 并发送光线在一线电子上。

sentences.en: Philo called it “light in a bottle.” Several days later, Philo told his teacher about a device that could capture pictures.
sentences.zh: Philo称其为“瓶子里的灯光 ” 。 几天后,Philo告诉他的老师一个可以捕捉照片的装置。

sentences.en: He drew a plan for it and gave it to his teacher.
sentences.zh: 他画了一个计划 并给了他的老师。

sentences.en: Philo’s drawing seemed very simple. But it still clearly showed the information needed to build a television.
sentences.zh: Philo的绘画似乎非常简单。 但它仍然清楚地展示了建立电视所需要的信息。

sentences.en: Philo’s teacher was Justin Tolman. Many years later, Philo would credit Mr.
sentences.zh: Philo的老师是Justin Tolman。 多年后,Philo将赞扬Justin Tolman先生。

sentences.en: Tolman with guiding his imagination and helping him open the doors of science.
sentences.zh: 托尔曼引导他的想象力 帮助他打开科学之门

sentences.en: Inventor In September 1927, Philo turned on a device that was the first working television receiver.
sentences.zh: 发明家 1927年9月,菲洛打开了一个装置 这是第一个工作电视接收器。

sentences.en: In another room was the first television camera.
sentences.zh: 在另一个房间是第一台电视摄影机。

sentences.en: Philo had invented the special camera tube earlier that year.
sentences.zh: Philo那年早些时候发明了特别摄像管

sentences.en: While the image produced on the receiver was not very clear, the device worked.
sentences.zh: 虽然接收器上生成的图像不太清楚,但装置起作用了。

sentences.en: Within a few months, Philo had found several people who wanted to invest money in his invention.
sentences.zh: 几个月后,菲洛发现几个人想投资他的发明。

sentences.en: In August 1930, the United States government gave Philo patent documents.
sentences.zh: 1930年8月,美国政府给了菲洛专利文件

sentences.en: These documents aimed to protect his invention from being copied by others.
sentences.zh: 这些文件旨在保护他的发明不被他人复制。

sentences.en: Still, he became involved in legal disputes with a powerful company at the time known as RCA.
sentences.zh: 然而,他仍然卷入了与一家被称为RCA的有权势公司的法律纠纷。

sentences.en: Philo won the disputes but faced many business and financial difficulties in his life.
sentences.zh: Philo赢得了这场争端,但一生面临许多商业和财政困难。

sentences.en: He developed more than 100 devices that helped make modern television possible.
sentences.zh: 他开发了100多台设备 帮助现代电视成为可能

sentences.en: He also developed early radar, invented the first electronic microscope, and worked on developing peaceful uses of atomic energy.
sentences.zh: 他还开发了早期雷达,发明了第一个电子显微镜,并致力于和平利用原子能。

sentences.en: Philo Farnsworth died in March of 1971. He is considered one of the most important inventors of the 20th century.
sentences.zh: Philo Farnsworth于1971年3月去世,被认为是20世纪最重要的发明者之一。

sentences.en: I’m John Russell. Paul Thompson wrote this story for VOA Learning English.
sentences.zh: 我是John Russell。Paul Thompson为VOA学习英语写了这个故事。

sentences.en: John Russell adapted it.
sentences.zh: John Russell改编的
